definition: A nuclear import adaptor protein encoded by the SNUPN gene that plays an essential role in the nuclear import and transport of spliceosomal small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs); biallelic loss-of-function or hypomorphic mutations in SNUPN disrupt this snRNP trafficking and pre-mRNA splicing, causing autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy (LGMDR29).

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: Snurportin-1, the protein encoded by SNUPN, plays an important role in the nuclear transport of small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs), essential components of the spliceosome.
